premises.text: Greener energy scale requires greener batteries because current battery metals are toxic and scarce
premises.evidence_span: The metals that we use in our current battery tech are not only toxic, but very scarce as well

premises.text: Hydrogel-reinforced cellulose paper batteries using zinc and manganese are compostable, flexible, and safe when damaged
premises.evidence_span: We have invented what we call hydrogel-reinforced cellulose paper, and utilize zinc and manganese as the two sides of the battery

premises.text: Paper cells can be stacked into plug-and-play shapes that replace lithium batteries using existing manufacturing processes
premises.evidence_span: stack up these paper batteries into the required shape and size, and we practically have a plug-and-play solution to replace any type of lithium batteries

premises.text: Abundant materials make the paper batteries about ten times cheaper than alternatives
premises.evidence_span: the cost of making our paper batteries isn't two times or three times cheaper, but it's 10 times cheaper

premises.text: Specialized paper-battery variants can serve energy storage, consumer tech, and EVs by tuning capacity, weight, and volume
premises.evidence_span: three versions of specialized paper batteries for a focused area of application

premises.text: Industry partners in energy storage and other verticals adopt the batteries into their products
premises.evidence_span: we are working with Collins and Powers, one of Singapore's largest energy storage solution providers

value.text: Safer, more sustainable, and cost-efficient batteries for a greener future
value.evidence_span: Sustainable, cost-effective, and so much safer than the ones we're using today

causal_links.evidence_span: a dream of a greener future demands greener batteries
safer, more sustainable, and cost-efficient future in battery tech
you finally have the dream of having green batteries in your EVs

notes: Compostable/flexible/cut-safe benefits folded into P2 as feature cascade of the paper chemistry. Energy-storage/consumer/EV uses folded into one specialized-variant premise (same mechanism, multiple applications). Revenue projections and team bios excluded. Singleton D1 retained as separately revisable market-need module.
